about: The technology stack's pins, one item per tool, runtime, image, data snapshot or external API the repository chooses a version of
and no package manager tracks (Pierre, 2026-11-05: the whole stack on the latest stable; AGENTS.md rule 27b). Bump a version
here and at every place its pins name, in the same PR: python3 tools/stack_check.py --check (CI, Checks job) fails when they
disagree; python3 tools/stack_check.py --latest looks each item up at its source and lists what is behind (the session brief
shows it once a day). GitHub Actions versions are Dependabot's (.github/dependabot.yml), not listed here.
Item fields: id, name, version (what the repository uses), pins (where it is written), latest (where stack_check.py looks up the
latest stable: a kind it knows plus its parameters; compare = major | minor | exact), lookup (the page a person reads), why.
A pin: files (globs from the repository root) with pattern ({v} stands for the version; every match must equal version, or one
of also, and min matches at least, default 1), or contains / lacks (text the files must or must not hold). optional: the files
may be missing (they arrive with another PR).

items.name: Node.js (CI)
items.why: The newest LTS major; setup-node follows its newest 26.x by itself.

items.name: Python (CI)
items.why: setup-python in every job that runs python3 (Checks, the smokes, Deploy Pages, Candidate photos, Photos to R2): one value everywhere.

items.name: GitHub runner image
items.why: An explicit label, so a new image is a reviewed one-line PR (the system packages change with it); --latest also says where ubuntu-latest points.

items.name: Prettier
items.why: Run with npx (no package.json, Pierre's rule). A new major reformats the code: one commit, listed in .git-blame-ignore-revs.

items.name: Playwright (smoke tests, Chromium)
items.why: npm install into a temporary folder on CI; the browser cache key carries the same version.

items.name: Pillow (photo pipeline)
items.why: Writes every WebP size (tools/photos.py). Dependabot (pip) proposes the next one; check the WebP output stays byte-identical.

items.name: rclone (photos to R2)
items.why: The official release, downloaded and checked against its pinned SHA-256 (tools/r2_sync.sh). To bump: the comment above RCLONE_VERSION there (signed SHA256SUMS line, changelog, a manual Photos to R2 run).

items.name: FishBase snapshot (rfishbase parquet)
items.why: FishBase names and photo lists for the fish subject; a new snapshot means re-running tools/fetch_fishbase.py and tools/fish_common.py.

items.name: iNaturalist API
items.why: v1 in most tools, v2 (the preferred one) in tools/fetch_fish.py: move each tool to v2 when it is touched, its output files checked identical. v1 has no shutdown date yet.

items.name: GitHub REST API version
items.why: No X-GitHub-Api-Version header is sent (admin.js, Code.gs isAdmin_), so GitHub applies its default, 2022-11-28 (supported to 2028-03-10). To move: send the header and turn this pin into a pattern.

items.name: Apps Script runtime (sheet script)
items.why: V8 is the only runtime (Rhino stopped 2026-01-31). --latest reads the sunset table for the runtime and the services the script uses.
